data.scope: S3b with dmin=0.1m (not original 0.04m). Central strip stays nonlinear, complete interface traces retained, remote undamaged secant K linearised at the prestressed initial state. Shared stable microstep, no multirate or contact reduction. Offline dense eigen build is charged separately and in wall time. Gains are CPU work estimates, not GPU timings.
